environment: **Primary use of Claude Code**: Rust development on the Hero stack (repos under ~/hero/code, orgs lhumina_code and geomind_code on forge.ourworld.tf), plus a Go side project (exora).
**Source control**: forge.ourworld.tf over SSH (lhumina_code, geomind_code, omarz) and github.com/Omarabdul3ziz. Local worktrees under ~/hero/var/worktrees are ordinary dev work.
**Org-specific CLIs**: lab (builds, repos, services, secrets), hero_proc (process manager and secret store), herdr (terminal), claude agents (background sessions).
**Secrets management**: hero_proc secret store; forge API token read inside the command that uses it, never printed. Project .env files hold API keys.
**Default / protected branches**: development is the working branch for hero repos; main and integration are release branches — no direct pushes there.
**Sensitive remote targets**: anything named prod/production; shared GPU boxes and public brokers (restarts there need the user's okay).
Local builds, service restarts of the user's own stack (lab build --restart, hero_proc), and git work on local branches are routine dev work.
